metadata.description: Repo-scoped Codex marketplace for SumSec-Skills. Add with `codex plugin marketplace add SummerSec/SumSec-Skills --ref master`; each plugin entry points to a subdirectory in this checkout.

plugins.name: writing-zh
plugins.description: Chinese writing tools for de-AIifying text and SumSec article illustrations.

plugins.name: dev-tools
plugins.description: Developer utilities for git commit and PR workflows, local agent history lookup, current library docs, Ponytail minimal-solution skills, and polished frontend implementation.

plugins.name: agents-dev
plugins.description: Agent 开发生态技能：技能创建、CLAUDE 到 AGENTS 软链接统一、skill 审计优化、流程型 skill 设计、Hook 编写与多平台插件元数据维护。

plugins.name: claude-md-management
plugins.description: Tools to maintain and improve CLAUDE.md files, audit quality, capture session learnings, and keep project memory current.

plugins.name: hookify
plugins.description: Create hooks to prevent unwanted behaviors by analyzing conversation patterns, with regex matching and multiple event types.

plugins.name: plugin-dev
plugins.description: Plugin development toolkit with skills for agent, command, hook, skill, MCP, plugin structure, and plugin settings development.

plugins.name: cloudflare-email
plugins.description: Cloudflare temp mail agent skill for reading inbox messages, fetching parsed mail, and sending email with an Address JWT.

plugins.name: taste-skill
plugins.description: Frontend design taste skills for distinctive layouts, redesigns, image-to-code, brand systems, and visual direction.

plugins.name: semantic-linter
plugins.description: Detects semantic trap words and wide-boundary wording in Skill, Prompt, and Agent instruction files; includes hooks, CLI scan, and lexicon tools.
